The game ''Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter'' and its expansion ''Balance of Power Campaigns'' do not provide any information about their timeline other than it takes place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]  ― [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]). Nevertheless, some clues permit to place the game and its expansion around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. ''X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter'' shows the Empire making extensive use of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s. The previous game of the series, [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], established that the TIE/ad starfighter was introduced during the [[Sepan campaign]] (which is set in 3 ABY per the reasoning [[Template:TIEFighterDate|here]]). We can conclude that the game is set between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. Moreover, the most advanced Imperial starfighters from ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' (the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/d "Defender" starfighter]] and the [[Missile Boat]]) were not present in ''X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter'', suggesting that the game takes place before their introduction, also dated to 3 ABY as the entire ''TIE Fighter'' game is set in 3 ABY (per the reasoning [[Template:TIEFighterDate|here]]).
